articles.title: Are software seats going away? (9 minute video)
articles.summary: Seat-based pricing remains standard, though companies are experimenting with usage tiers and add-ons due to AI. Despite pricing complexity, businesses must still focus on core willingness-to-pay features like security and admin controls.

articles.title: Just-in-Time Requirements
articles.summary: When exploring solutions in parallel, teams should maintain a living outline to connect efforts and guide investment. When scoping becomes repetitive, AI can help consolidate learning into key requirements and delivery plans.

articles.title: Great but painful
articles.summary: Successful consumer tech products succeed by reducing friction in existing, painful user behaviors rather than building what users ask for, as seen with Facebook, Uber, and Slack.

articles.title: Why Most of What You Build Creates No Value
articles.summary: Most features fail because changing user behavior is hard. Frameworks like GIST and the Confidence Meter help validate ideas before shipping, remaining essential even as AI speeds up coding.

articles.title: The CIA Sabotage Manual for Product Organizations
articles.summary: Product team dysfunctions often mimic a 1944 CIA sabotage manual through excessive approvals and meeting slowness. Naming these behaviors helps teams recognize and address self-sabotaging friction.

articles.title: Fluency with data
articles.summary: Data fluency turns data into actionable insights and business outcomes. This article introduces a causality ladder and notes how AI tools streamline data investigation when paired with rigorous testing.

articles.title: Inside PM at Anthropic: Who Makes It, and Who Doesn't (59 minute podcast)
articles.summary: This post details how Anthropic hires PMs. The company expects new hires to tackle demanding work, gracefully challenge assumptions, and balance short-term plans with long-term research.

articles.title: The 8 AI PM Skills Self-Check
articles.summary: AI PM candidates often lack hands-on evaluation skills. This article provides an eight-skill self-check framework that prioritizes practical execution in evals, agents, and cost calculations over theory.

articles.title: Outcome-based pricing
articles.summary: This post covers challenges in outcome-based pricing like attribution and metric gaming, suggesting hybrid models with base fees and shared risk as a practical solution.

articles.title: Journey Mapping Essentials
articles.summary: Journey mapping should drive action rather than just document processes.
